SELECT O.ID, O.STAFF_BADGE, F.NAME, F.COMP_NAME, F.DEP_NAME, F.JOB_NAME, O.START_TIME, O.PROCESS_ID, O.ALLOWANCE_TYPE, O.AMOUNT, O.COMPUTAION_RULE, O.EXPLAIN, O.REMARK, O.CREATE_TIME, O.STATUS, O.OUT_ADDRESS FROM SMT_OUT_DORMITORY_STAFF O INNER JOIN SMT_STAFF F ON O.STAFF_BADGE=F.BADGE where IS_DELETE=0
AND O.STAFF_BADGE LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{query.staffBadge}),'%')
AND F.NAME LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{query.staffName}),'%')
AND O.CREATE_TIME between to_date(#{query.startTime},'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') and to_date(#{query.endTime},'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss')
AND F.COMP_ID IN ( SELECT DISTINCT SPB.COMP_ID from SMT_PARK_BU SPB
SPB.PARK_ID IN
#{id}
)
ORDER BY O.CREATE_TIME DESC
